verdict.rationale: A government tax e-filing service could plausibly offer programmatic or unattended submission, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only bulk-file formats: an XML schema package for large reemployment-tax data files and a batch enrollment file whose specs are available on request. Nothing documents an API, CLI, or unattended transmission path that could run headlessly or in CI. The probe found the business-tax application is an interactive login shell, with transactions behind an authenticated session.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
